doc.name: EasyCircuit
doc.instructions: EasyCircuit is an electronics prototyping tool with a parts catalog and wiring checks. Use it whenever the user is planning, wiring, or debugging a hobby electronics prototype (a microcontroller board with sensors, displays, motors, pumps, LEDs, or batteries), including when they say they are stuck. Answer pin questions from get_part_pins rather than memory. When a prototype misbehaves (it resets, a display stays blank, a sensor reads zero, a motor or pump will not run), write the user's wiring as a design and run check_design: it finds missing grounds, unwired power pins, wrong pins, and loads with no supply of their own. If the user has not described their parts and wiring yet, ask for them and offer this check. To design a circuit: use search_parts to pick real parts, get_part_pins for their exact pinouts, write the design JSON, run check_design, fix every blocking issue and every real designWarning, then call save_design and give the user the link so they can open, edit, and build it in the EasyCircuit editor. Pin facts are reference data: say when a fact is unverified, and never invent pins. Do not design mains (wall AC) wiring.

tools.name: search_parts
tools.title: Search parts catalog
tools.description: Searches EasyCircuit's electronics parts catalog by name, function or role (for example 'OLED display', 'temperature sensor', 'ESP32 board'). Returns matching parts with their catalog ids, interfaces, pin roles, and whether each can be ordered in a kit.

query.description: What the part is or does.

role.description: Optional circuit role, e.g. controller, sensor, load.

availability.description: one_click limits results to parts orderable in a kit.

tools.name: get_part
tools.title: Get part details
tools.description: Returns one catalog part by its catalog id, including its pin evidence and electrical capabilities.

tools.name: get_part_pins
tools.title: Get part pinout
tools.description: Returns the pinout of an exact part: each pin's function, voltage, direction and polarity, with the source of each fact and any conflicting sources. Long pinouts are paged; next_offset is the offset of the next page.

query.description: Exact part name, catalog id, or part number.

tools.name: get_part_capabilities
tools.title: Get part capabilities
tools.description: Returns the electrical capabilities of an exact part: pin roles, drive type, voltage ranges, required terminals, protocols, and whether each fact is physically verified.

query.description: Exact part name, catalog id, or part number.

tools.name: catalog_summary
tools.title: Catalog summary
tools.description: Counts catalog parts by status and role.

tools.name: check_design
tools.title: Check circuit design
tools.description: Runs EasyCircuit's wiring checks on a complete circuit design without saving it. Returns status (passed or blocked), blockingIssues that prevent saving, designWarnings from general electrical rules (such as a part with no ground pin) that do not apply to every part, and reviewWarnings for pin facts that are not yet physically verified.

design.description: A complete circuit. nets: {net_id: {label, color '#rrggbb'}}. components: [{id, name, type: controller|sensor|switch|power|load|bus|protection|camera|assembly|wiring, pins: [{id, label, side: left|right, net}]}]. connections: [{id, from: 'componentId.pinId', to: 'componentId.pinId', net}]. Ids are short lowercase strings and pin labels are the part's real pin labels. The wiring checks expect every wired part's power and GND pins to be wired, a common GND, VCC, GND, SDA and SCL on I2C devices, and a battery or power-supply component for motors, pumps, solenoids and heaters.

tools.name: save_design
tools.title: Save design to EasyCircuit
tools.description: Saves a circuit design that has no blocking wiring issues and returns a link that opens it in the EasyCircuit editor, with schematic, breadboard and perfboard views, editing, and parts ordering. Anyone with the link can open a copy. Designs with blocking issues are not saved.

Ids are short lowercase strings and pin labels are the part's real pin labels. The wiring checks expect every wired part's power and GND pins to be wired, a common GND, VCC, GND, SDA and SCL on I2C devices, and a battery or power-supply component for motors, pumps, solenoids and heaters.
